title: Bead aggregation assay to demonstrate presynaptic differentiation induced by the NGL family of cell adhesion molecules
protocol: Transfect HEK293T cells with NGL-2-Ecto-Fc.
Incubate for 2 days, then change to serum-free medium.
Incubate the serum-free medium for a further 3 days.
Purify NGL-2-Ecto-Fc from the serum-free medium using protein-A sepharose.
Mix 5 μg of NGL-2-Ecto-Fc with 5 μg of biotin-conjugated anti-human antibodies and 2 μL of neutravidin-conjugated FluoSphere beads.
Incubate the mixture for 1 hour.
Increase the volume to 1 mL by adding Hank's balanced salt solution (HBSS).
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 1 minute in a microcentrifuge.
Remove the supernatant carefully and resuspend the precipitates in 100 μL of conditioned media where neurons were growing.
Place coverslips with cultured neurons face-up on 6-well dishes.
Add 100 μL of the resuspended beads onto the neurons.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes without drying the coverslips.
Wash the neurons twice with HBSS.
Return the coverslip to the conditioned media and incubate for 24 hours.
Fix and immunostain the neurons with primary antibodies against various synaptic proteins and fluorophore-conjugated secondary antibodies.
Capture Z-stacked images by confocal immunofluorescence microscopy as well as DIC imaging.
Manually trace the boundaries of the beads for quantitation.
Copy a bead boundary to a nearby axonal region for normalization.
Determine the mean immunofluorescence intensity of a synaptic marker in a bead area.
Normalize the mean immunofluorescence intensity by that from a nearby control area.
